lines.zh: 我贴着墙往上攀，像真的藤。
lines.en: I climb the wall like real ivy.

lines.zh: 卷须一节节伸出去，又收回来。
lines.en: My tendrils reach out joint by joint and pull back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪动，叶子跟着颤。
lines.en: I shift slowly, and the leaves tremble with me.
I creep across the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我把卷须搭到更高的枝上。
lines.en: I hook a tendril on a higher branch.

lines.zh: 我沿着天花板挪了半米。
lines.en: I move half a meter along the ceiling.
I leave a damp trail.

lines.zh: 我绕过铁栏，不碰出声响。
lines.en: I slip around the iron bars without a sound.

lines.zh: 我从灌木里长出来，又长回去。
lines.en: I grow out of the bush, then back in.
I quietly reach behind you.

lines.zh: 我挪得很慢，你看不出来。
lines.en: I move so slowly you can't tell.
I've taken a whole wall.

lines.zh: 我垂着，和别的藤没什么两样。
lines.en: I hang here, no different from the other vines.
When the wind blows, I sway along.
I arrange my leaves a little neater.
I wait for someone to walk past.

lines.zh: 我的卷须慢慢卷成一个圈。
lines.en: My tendril curls slowly into a loop.

lines.zh: 有只虫爬到我身上，我没动。
lines.en: A bug crawls on me; I don't move.

lines.zh: 阳光照着我，我装得很像。
lines.en: Sunlight finds me, and I play my part well.

lines.zh: 我把自己从墙上收回来一点。
lines.en: I pull myself back from the wall a bit.
I like damp places.
I count the drips from the eaves.
I've climbed this wall many times.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地张开一片叶子。
lines.en: I slowly unfurl one leaf.

lines.zh: 没有人的时候，我最自在。
lines.en: With no one around, I'm most at ease.
I can smell the water in the soil.

lines.zh: 有小鸟想在我身上做窝。
lines.en: A little bird wants to nest on me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像已经枯了。
lines.en: I lie still, as if already withered.

lines.zh: 我把触须盘到柱子后面。
lines.en: I coil a tendril behind the post.
Waiting this long doesn't tire me.
You've touched one of my leaves.
You look up; I'm above you.

lines.zh: 这面墙上的藤，比昨天多。
lines.en: There's more ivy on this wall than yesterday.

lines.zh: 你走过的时候，我抖了一下。
lines.en: When you passed, I twitched.
Stop feeling; my skin is thin.
Look at that tendril. It's moving, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我挂在那里，装作没听见。
lines.en: I hang there and pretend not to hear.
The sap on your hand is mine.
Do you climb walls too?
This place is damp; it suits me.
You smiled; I saw it.

lines.zh: 藤下面通常没有东西，这次有。
lines.en: Nothing usually hides under vines. This time, something does.
My leaves are crushed.
It hurts; my tendril snapped.
Sap leaks from the break.
I pull back into the wall.
That tore off a large patch.
My roots aren't deep; it hurts.
I twitch and shed torn leaves.
The wind is cold on the wound.

lines.zh: 我装成藤蔓你也看得出。
lines.en: You saw through my vine disguise.
I must withdraw and regrow.
That warm dampness draws me near.
There's an insect on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你把水浇在墙根，我伸过去了。
lines.en: You pour water at the wall's base and I reach for it.

lines.zh: 有人在这里生了火，太干了。
lines.en: Someone lit a fire here; too dry.
Your breath is right beside me.
That wet cloth suits me well.
I crawl up along the water stain.
You're standing too close. Good.

lines.zh: 这点温度，隔着叶子也感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel that warmth even through the leaves.

lines.zh: 我把卷须慢慢松开一点。
lines.en: I let my tendril slacken a little.
You crash into the vines and get caught.
My tendril hooks your shoulder.
I let go so you can go on.

lines.zh: 你拨开叶子，我缩了一下。
lines.en: You push the leaves aside and I flinch.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，落了一身叶子。
lines.en: We collide and leaves rain down.

lines.zh: 你踩到我从墙上垂下的那截。
lines.en: You step on the part I let down.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，贴到另一边墙上。
lines.en: I slip around you onto the other wall.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的卷须断了一根。
lines.en: That cost me one tendril.

lines.zh: 你拍掉身上的叶子，那都是我。
lines.en: You brush the leaves off; they were me.
You press me flat against the wall.
Another cluster of tendrils winds toward me.
We climb, winding around each other.
Its leaves are greener than mine.
Our sap mingles.
Two vines have grown into one.

lines.zh: 我们一起盖住了整面墙。
lines.en: Together we've covered the whole wall.
Its tendrils are gentle.
At night we coil tightly together.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，晃一晃就够了。
lines.en: We need no words; a sway is enough.
Next year we'll fill this place.

lines.zh: 我用卷须卷起一枚铁粒。
lines.en: I curl a tendril around an iron nugget.

lines.zh: 那根落下的树枝，我收好了。
lines.en: I've taken the fallen branch.

lines.zh: 我把东西拖进叶子里藏起来。
lines.en: I drag it under the leaves to hide it.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉进藤里，找不到了。
lines.en: Your thing fell into the vines; it's gone.
This button stays on me.

lines.zh: 我把骨头缠起来，慢慢吞。
lines.en: I wrap the bone and take it in slowly.
That cloth will cover me nicely.

lines.zh: 我卷起一小块泥土，收着。
lines.en: I curl up a clod of soil to keep.
I take the fruit from the ground.

lines.zh: 我把它挂在高处，够不着。
lines.en: I hang it high, out of reach.
You've seen through me, haven't you.
Then I'll stop pretending.
My hand is behind your back.
You snapped my vine; it hurt.

lines.zh: 你离得太近了，来不及退。
lines.en: You're too close to pull away.
The leaves rise one by one.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的脚，你就明白了。
lines.en: I wrap your ankle, and then you'll understand.

lines.zh: 这里是我长起来的地方。
lines.en: This is where I grew.
You want to cut me? Try.
I've been waiting for you to come near.

lines.zh: 藤蔓是我身上的一部分。
lines.en: The vine is part of my body.
You step back; I grow an inch.
Something's moving on the ceiling.
I wrap a tendril round the handle.
You're already inside me.
I'm not fast, but you can't leave.
My eyes are in the leaves.

lines.zh: 我收紧一点，再收紧一点。
lines.en: I tighten a little, then a little more.

lines.zh: 这个角落，我早就占好了。
lines.en: I claimed this corner long ago.
The wind has stopped; I haven't.
A tendril whips your leg.
I loop your wrist and twist.
Spines show under the leaves.
I drag you toward the corner.
You break free, but not far.
This one opens your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的力气全都收在一处。
lines.en: All my strength gathers in one spot.
You're lifted slightly off the ground.
I let go and you drop.

lines.zh: 我还在动，别以为结束了。
lines.en: I'm still moving; don't think it's over.
The ivy in the corner is thicker than yesterday.
I grow out of the brick seam.

lines.zh: 这里的叶子忽然多了起来。
lines.en: The leaves here suddenly multiplied.
Overnight the wall turned green.
I root into the beam.
Someone heard a sound inside the wall.
I reach in under the window.
The dampness rose, and I woke.
This is good ground for growing.

lines.zh: 叶子上还挂着露水，我已经在了。
lines.en: Dew still hangs on the leaves; I'm already here.

lines.zh: 我以为这里没人，原来有。
lines.en: I thought this place was empty. It isn't.
I quietly claimed this patch.
Fire! My leaves curl and crackle.
I drop off the wall and come apart.
Too much water; my roots smother.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的藤全掀起来。
lines.en: The blast rips my vines loose.
An arrow pins my stem.

lines.zh: 法术一碰，我的叶就枯了。
lines.en: One touch of that spell and my leaves wither.

lines.zh: 这里的土太瘦，我撑不住。
lines.en: This soil is too poor to hold me.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的藤都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my vines scorch.

lines.zh: 虚空把根从土里扯出来。
lines.en: The void tears my roots out of the earth.
